Hi Ana,

Thanks for reaching out to us. We understand you're looking to sublet your apartment (12E) from April to June while you're in Lisbon, and we appreciate you suggesting a potential subtenant.

To properly address your subletting request, we need to review your lease agreement regarding subletting policies. Could you please provide us with a copy of your lease agreement, or at least the relevant section about subletting? This will help us determine the next steps and any required procedures.

Regarding your inquiry about pausing or reducing rent during your absence, we will also need to review your lease agreement and company policy to see if this is a possibility. We will look into this and get back to you as soon as possible.

We appreciate your patience as we look into these matters.

ManageCo Property Management

We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this.

ManageCo Property Management
